title: The Sourdough Handbook
subtitle: A practical guide to making sourdough bread, from first starter to fixing a bad loaf, with a worked example for planning an overnight feed.

parts.title: Start here
parts.intro: How to use this handbook, and what to note while you bake.

parts.title: The Sourdough Guide
parts.intro: A practical reference for making sourdough bread, from first starter to troubleshooting a bad loaf. Figures are typical ranges, not laws: every kitchen, flour and starter behaves a little differently, so treat the dough (not the clock) as the final judge.

parts.title: Worked examples
parts.intro: Full bakes from feed to carve, one example each: three days with an overnight feed, two days, the same day, after work and two loaves.

parts.title: Appendix
parts.intro: Conversions and US names for readers who use cups and Fahrenheit.
